title: bool and char keys keep their category
purpose: Observe type, generic and collection semantics.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 6.3: bool and char keys keep their type. Language owner decision, 21.10.2026 (D-047): one map literal has exactly one key type, so keys of different types are not mixed.
